rows.text: unlinks node `rdx` from a doubly linked list (qword `+0x18` and qword `+0x20` links): when its `+0x20` neighbour is non-null that neighbour's qword `+0x18` takes `rdx`'s `+0x18`, when its `+0x18` neighbour is non-null that neighbour's qword `+0x20` takes `rdx`'s `+0x20`, and both of `rdx`'s links are zeroed; it returns `rcx`, or `rcx`'s qword `+0x18` (read before the unlink) when `rdx` equals `rcx`

returns 1 when `rcx` is null, its qword `+0xC0` is null, or the dword at that pointer is -1; otherwise takes the word at that pointer, returns 0 when it is -1, when the `0x740`-stride record it indexes from qword `022C6F28` has a zero address, or when that record's dword `+0x284` is zero, and else returns 1 when bit 3 (`0x8`) of that dword is clear and 0 when it is set

returns 0 when bit `0x10` of byte `02089340` is clear; otherwise passes the result of the call at `00322950` + 0xD to the call at `00322950` + 0x1A and that result with 0 to the call at `00322950` + 0x29, returning 0 if either of the first two results is null and else 1 when the last call returns 0 and 0 when it returns non-zero
scans the dword `022C83F0` (signed count) dwords starting at `022C83F8` and returns 1 when one of them equals `ecx`, otherwise 0 (also 0 when the count is zero or less)

zeroes qwords `+0xB0`, `+0xB8` and `+0xC0` of node `rdx` on every path, then returns `rdx` when `rcx` is null; otherwise descends a binary tree from `rcx`, taking qword `+0xB8` when the current node's float `+0xC8` is greater than `rdx`'s float `+0xC8` and qword `+0xB0` otherwise (equal or unordered included), stores `rdx` into the first null child slot, stores that parent into `rdx`'s qword `+0xC0`, and returns `rcx`
